label: API Keys & Environment
description: How to access API keys, env vars, and filesystem paths inside the container.

aspects.name: access_patterns
attributes: Use env_manage tool: action="list" to see all keys, action="get" key="X" for a specific one
Keys in /data/.env — pre-loaded into process.env at startup
Set new keys: env_manage action="set" key="X" value="Y" — persists across restarts

aspects.name: available_keys
attributes: BFL_API_KEY — Black Forest Labs / FLUX image generation
XI_API_KEY — ElevenLabs TTS and sound effects

aspects.name: filesystem_paths
attributes: /workspace/web/ — publicly served at your web URL
Never log or print full API key values

aspects.name: storage_location
attributes: API keys are stored in the /data/.env file.

aspects.name: test_keys
attributes: TELEGRAM_TEST=hello_from_anima is present in the .env file as test clutter.
